name: metagpt

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. MetaGPT defaults to GPT-4-class models for the architect role.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed roles.

METAGPT_CONFIG.description: Path to MetaGPT's config2.yaml. Defaults to ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml.

WORKSPACE.description: Directory MetaGPT writes generated software-team artifacts into. Defaults to ./workspace.

notes: Software-company-as-agents framework — runs PM, architect, engineer, QA roles in sequence. MONITOR tier — produces code, docs, and tests in WORKSPACE; every artifact is reviewed before promotion. License is MIT.
